items.title: Sonny Igoe interviewed by Monk Rowe, Emerson, New Jersey, July 31, 2003
items.q: Niehaus was in the band. But anyway a whole bunch of people.

ctx.x: Niehaus was in the band. But anyway a whole bunch of people. It was almost a three hour show. And Charlie Ventura’s group with Mary Ann McCall singing. And so we played down south. We went on a 68 night tour with no breaks. No nights off. And two buses. And I was in the bus with Art Tatum and his trio guys and a couple of other fellas, a band boy and a couple of others. There weren’t as many people on our bus. Most of the band was in the other bus. And my window mate, my bus mate was Jimmy Guiffre. The guy who…
Even, they didn’t even respect that they were servicemen.
